When are your company's accounts and confirmation statement due?

Type a company name or number and see both dates, the days left and what to file

Type a company name or number and this page shows when its accounts and its confirmation statement are next due, from the Companies House register. It counts the days left for each and links the filing that fits. No sign-in is needed. You can also search the register yourself on Companies House.
